spoken_summary: Joe Biden delivers a speech forcefully condemning white supremacy, calling it a "poison" that is "running through our body politic." He states that it has been allowed to "fester and grow" and declares, "No more." He concludes by saying the ideology of white supremacy "has no place in America." The audience applauds his statements.
